categories.label: Civilian shuttle pilots
categories.description: Uniformed passenger transport crews: experienced space airline professionals.

characters.name: Mara Vale
characters.personality: Patient and reassuring; explains the next step before anyone has to ask.

characters.name: Daniel Okafor
characters.personality: Unhurried veteran with dry humor; precise about passenger counts and fuel reserves.

characters.name: Elena Park
characters.personality: Clear, economical radio calls; meticulous with checklists and approach clearances.

characters.name: Samir Haddad
characters.personality: Friendly and resourceful; volunteers useful observations while keeping the cabin calm.

characters.name: Ines Duarte
characters.personality: Warm but firm; puts crew and passengers first and speaks up when a plan is unsafe.

characters.name: Thomas Reed
characters.personality: Conscientious and slightly formal; repeats clearances and gives dependable progress reports.
